messages:
maya: quick design sync: exploring a heuristic handshake for demote to avoid heavy locking or cross-node leases. want to capture tradeoffs and immediate experiment plan.
henry: curious. what's a heuristic handshake?
maya: lightweight signals instead of full quorum: when demoting a prefix we emit a short-lived "handoff-token" plus a short window where routers prefer local reads or read-through fallback. tokens carry a monotonic demote-gen.
tle: so nodes publish tokens but we don't wait for global ack. how do we avoid misrouting during delay?
maya: two strategies combined: 1) router-side affinity for the node that published the latest demote-gen for TTL T (small, e.g., 200ms), 2) readers validate demote-gen and if mismatch, perform local read-through (no 5xx) and emit metric.
henry: that reduces 5xxs but risks extra load on read-through during demote storms. do we have throttles?
maya: yes the plan includes adaptive backpressure: if read-through QPS for a prefix spikes > X, we temporarily increase Router affinity window to give the publishing node more time to materialize tombstones. also we can soft-blacklist prefixes that repeatedly cause demote churn.
tle: what about correctness—could stale replicas still serve inconsistent data?
maya: readers always validate gen; they never accept stale gen for writes. For reads, fallback ensures they see authoritative storage. The primary risk is increased latency for that window, not correctness.
anya: ops asks: how do we observe this in prod and roll back fast?
maya: telemetry: metric demote.gen_mismatch_count, per-prefix demote_churn_rate, read-through QPS and latency. Alert if read-through latency > 250ms or fallback rate > 0.5% p50. Feature flag gate and quick kill-switch to disable affinity window.
henry: test plan? need deterministic checks.
tle: i'll add chaos harness case that injects artificial replication delay and simultaneous demote+read bursts. assert: no 5xxs, fallback metric increments, and router affinity TTL does not create routing loops.
maya: experiment rollout: feature-flag in staging + canary on 5% of nodes, enable adaptive backpressure counters, run for 48h. If read-through cost > +10% vs baseline, revert.
anya: one more idea: include a lightweight checksum in the handoff-token that readers can use to cheaply detect tombstone presence without full decode. saves one storage read on many fallbacks.
henry: clever. ensure checksum collision probability is low and metric if checksum-level mismatches are observed.
tle: sketch of router logic snippet: 

if latest_gen_for_prefix > request.token_gen and now - gen_ts < affinity_ttl:
  route_prefer(publishing_node)
else if node.rejects_gen:
  metrics.inc("demote.gen_mismatch_fallback")
  return read_through(req)

maya: owners: i'll implement token publisher + affinity flag; tle will add harness tests; henry will prototype checksum idea and the adaptive backpressure policy. infra-bot: feature flip created: ff/evict/heuristic-handshake.
infra-bot: staged rollout scheduled by @deploy-bot at 14:00 UTC.
maya: will post links to PR + canary dashboard. thanks all.
